findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 placeholders in research commands

evidence.observation: TODO comments indicate missing Phase 5 functionality: authorization checking via Supabase, integration with decision_to_memory, and placeholder Phase 5 logic.

proposed_action.description: Implement Supabase authorization checks and decision_to_memory integration or remove stubbed Phase 5 TODOs.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures research commands adhere to planned Supabase authorization and persistence contracts.

findings.title: Unimplemented quality anomalies query in quality forecasting

evidence.observation: TODO comment indicates hardcoded empty list for recent_anomalies instead of querying quality_anomalies table.

proposed_action.description: Implement database query to retrieve actual records from quality_anomalies table.

findings.expected_benefit: Improves accuracy of quality forecasting by analyzing historical anomalies.

findings.title: Model router call log file is absent

evidence.observation: Model router call_log_exists is reported as false for expected path /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl.

proposed_action.description: Ensure model router creates and persists inference call events into call_log.jsonl.

findings.expected_benefit: Enables metric auditing, latency tracking, and error logging across model router invocations.

findings.title: Direct provider API calls bypassing model router in emergency alert summary

evidence.observation: emergency_alert module executes direct calls via call_gemini and call_mistral rather than dispatching through model router endpoint.

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM queries through the centralized model router using appropriate task types.

findings.expected_benefit: Maintains unified model policy, telemetry, latency tracking, and fallback capabilities.
